valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5.225e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (TradingView scanner (total_shares_outstanding); price 12.84 EGP)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a compound growth rate of earnings is not defined from the periods on file: it needs net profit POSITIVE in BOTH endpoint years (FY2021 and FY2025), and one of them is not. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the FY2025 earnings on file, net profit 3,230,000 on revenue 5,420,000 and equity 12,080,000, rest on a third-party feed (StockAnalysis, read 2026-10-07) rather than a filing held locally, so the earnings row behind this P/E cannot be certified from a primary source. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/S computed from the inputs on file (123.78) is not a valuation for a real business. A price 124 times revenue means the revenue row (5,420,000 EGP against a market capitalisation of 670,887,600) is not commensurate with the company, so the P/S is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the FY2025 earnings on file, net profit 3,230,000 on revenue 5,420,000 and equity 12,080,000, rest on a third-party feed (StockAnalysis, read 2026-10-07) rather than a filing held locally, so the earnings row behind this P/E cannot be certified from a primary source. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
